events.title: Steam Next Fest Entry
events.summary: We are very happy to be in our first Next Fest. We hope that everyone that plays the game will be able to enjoy the improvements and updates we made. We are so grateful for the people that gave us feedback so we were able to get to this new demo!Here is a more complete list of the improvements and changes:Partial Brazilian Portuguese localizationNew main menuBuilding effect reworkInfo box reworkBug fixes and general polishAnd lots more fixes and QOL improvements

events.title: Demo Update #3 – Next Fest Entry
events.summary: After collecting feedback from our first demo, we were able to focus on the biggest pain points, such as text being hard to understand and the duration of Fearsome Mode being unclear.We've been hard at work implementing these improvements, along with many other major updates.The new build is almost here, keep your eyes peeled for more news!

events.title: Demo Update #2
events.summary: As the project moves along we are aiming to identify and solve problems with the accessibility, the UX, and any bugs we find. The last hot fix and this update bring in options to make streaming and content creation easier. Along with that we are working on various quality of life improvements as we get feedback from the community Here you can find the list of changes in this update: Added feedback for constructing buildings;Added the option of a Public Domain soundtrack for content creators;New

events.title: v0.5.8b - Accessibility Hotfix
events.summary: After some feedback, we moved the accessibility option to reduce the retro filters higher up in our priorities. The option can be found in the Options menu, but the retro filters will remain on by default.Added the option to turn off the pixelization filter on the board;Added the option to turn off the walkman filter on music and sound effects. Wishing you all a good hunt and a wicked night!
